Hi team,

Quick heads-up on AcroLabs (annual renewal in 2028-10): finance wants a clean commit by end of Q3 so we can lock ARR into the Q4 forecast. Attached is the renewal package and a mutual action plan I pulled from the account folder.

Asking for two things from our side by next Monday (2028-06-04 EOD PT):
- Ben: confirm today's true stage (Commit / Procurement pending / At Risk) and any outstanding billing blockers.
- Naomi: pull the last three CS touch notes and flag any product/regressions that could influence churn scoring.

Customer context (brief): James mentioned they have an internal procurement review and a potential holdback request tied to usage-based overage caps. Procurement is in the loop (procurement@acrolabs.com). We should anticipate a one-week negotiation on terms if they ask for credits.

Also tagging the related HubSpot record and DocuSign link below so finance and sales can coordinate.

Attachments: AcroLabs_Q4_Renewal_Package_2028.xlsx (renewal terms, usage trends), AcroLabs_Mutual_Action_Plan_2028.docx

Thanks — I want a quick standup at 10am PT on Monday if we have conflicting notes.
